name: IC Driver Motor — 30V — QFP
description: Motor driver IC cluster with 30V rating in surface-mount QFP packaging, featuring the LQFP-44 10x10mm footprint.
selection_hints: Requires a 30V rated motor driver IC.
Targeting surface-mount QFP packaging, such as the LQFP-44 10x10mm footprint with 0.8mm pitch.
Selecting tier A parts from KiCad symbols such as TMC2660.
avoid_when: The application requires an operating voltage other than 30V.
The design requires through-hole assembly instead of SMD.
A package family other than QFP or footprint other than LQFP-44 10x10mm is required.
